A REFINED RIDE

With advanced Electronic Vehicle Architecture (EVA 2,0), recalibrated handling and throttle response

and the new Dynamic Launch feature, F-PACE SVR 575 Edition delivers an exceptional performance.

FULLER SOUND

Experience the crisp, hard-edged thunder of the Jaguar F-PACE SVR 575 Edition soundtrack with the Variable Valve Active Exhaust System.

EXTERIOR DESIGN

Larger air intakes, bonnet vents, side fender vents and rear spoiler reduce drag for better handling.

INTERIOR DESIGN

Front and rear Performance seats in Semi-Aniline leather, new steering wheel and intuitive Pivi Pro infotainment system.
